symptoms.symptom: Tea residue or lipstick marks on dishware.

causes.label: Dishwashing temperature is too low.
remedies: Select a program with a higher dishwashing temperature.
causes.evidence: Bosch manual, page 29: "Dishwashing temperature is too low."

causes.label: Too little detergent is being used or is unsuitable.
remedies: Use a suitable Detergent and follow the manufacturer's instructions for the amount to be used.
causes.evidence: Bosch manual, page 29: "Too little detergent is being used or is unsuitable."

causes.label: Dishware has been precleaned too intensively. Then the sensors choose a lighter cycle. Stubborn remnants cannot be entirely removed.
remedies: Only remove large remnants of food and do not pre-rinse dishware.
causes.evidence: Bosch manual, page 29: "Dishware has been precleaned too intensively. Then the sensors choose a lighter cycle. Stubborn remnants cannot be entirely removed."

symptoms.symptom: Plastic parts inside the appliance are discolored.

causes.label: Plastic parts inside the appliance may become discolored over the life of the dishwasher.
remedies: Discoloration may come about and will not impair functioning of the appliance.
causes.evidence: Bosch manual, page 29: "Plastic parts inside the appliance may become discolored over the life of the dishwasher."

causes.label: Dishwashing temperature is too low.
remedies: Select a program with a higher dishwashing temperature.
causes.evidence: Bosch manual, page 29: "Dishwashing temperature is too low."

causes.label: Dishware has been precleaned too intensively. Then the sensors choose a lighter cycle. Stubborn remnants cannot be entirely removed.
remedies: Only remove large remnants of food and do not pre-rinse dishware.
causes.evidence: Bosch manual, page 29: "Dishware has been precleaned too intensively. Then the sensors choose a lighter cycle. Stubborn remnants cannot be entirely removed."

symptoms.symptom: There are removable streaks on glasses, glassware with a metallic appearance and silverware.

causes.label: Amount of rinse aid to be dispensed is set too high.
remedies: Set the rinse aid system to a lower setting.
→ "Setting the amount of rinse aid", Page 14
causes.evidence: Bosch manual, page 29: "Amount of rinse aid to be dispensed is set too high."

causes.label: No rinse aid has been added.
remedies: Add rinse aid.
→ "Adding rinse aid", Page 14
causes.evidence: Bosch manual, page 29: "No rinse aid has been added."

causes.label: There is detergent residue in the final rinse. Lid of detergent dispenser is blocked by dishware and will not open fully.
remedies: Arrange dishware in the upper rack so the tab collecting tray is not obstructed by
dishware.
→ "Loading dishware", Page 17
causes.evidence: Bosch manual, page 29: "There is detergent residue in the final rinse. Lid of detergent dispenser is blocked by dishware and will not open fully."

causes.label: Glasses are not dishwasher-proof, only suitable for dishwashers.
remedies: Use dishwasher-proof glasses.
Glasses are usually only suitable for cleaning in a dishwasher, i.e. long-term wear or long-term changes must be expected.
Avoid a lengthy steam phase (standing time after wash cycle ends).
Use a program with a lower temperature.
Use detergent with a glass protection component.
causes.evidence: Bosch manual, page 30: "Glasses are not dishwasher-proof, only suitable for dishwashers."

symptoms.symptom: Home Connect cannot be implemented correctly.

causes.label: Home Connect set incorrectly.
remedies: Please consult the documents supplied for Home Connect®.
causes.evidence: Bosch manual, page 30: "Home Connect set incorrectly."

causes.label: There is a technical error.
remedies: Please consult the information on support in the documents supplied for Home Connect®.
causes.evidence: Bosch manual, page 30: "There is a technical error."

symptoms.symptom: Refill indicator for rinse aid lights up.

causes.label: No rinse aid.
remedies: Add Rinse aid → Page 14.
Set the amount of rinse aid to be dispensed.
→ "Setting the amount of rinse aid", Page 14
causes.evidence: Bosch manual, page 30: "No rinse aid."

symptoms.symptom: Refill indicator for rinse aid does not light up.

causes.label: Rinse aid system is switched off.
remedies: Set the amount of rinse aid.
→ "Setting the amount of rinse aid", Page 14
causes.evidence: Bosch manual, page 30: "Rinse aid system is switched off."

symptoms.symptom: All LEDs light up or flash.

causes.label: Electronics have detected a fault.
remedies: Press the main switch button for approx. 4 seconds.
→ "Controls", Page 8 The appliance is reset and restarted.
If the problem occurs again:
‒   Switch off the appliance.
‒   Unplug the power plug or switch off the circuit breaker in the fuse box.
‒   Wait at least 2 minutes.
‒   Switch on the circuit breaker in the fuse box or plug in the power plug.
‒   Switch on the appliance.
If the problem occurs again:
‒ Contact customer service.
→ "Customer Service", Page 33
causes.evidence: Bosch manual, page 31: "Electronics have detected a fault."

symptoms.symptom: Water is left in the appliance at the end of the program.

causes.label: Filter system or area under the filters is blocked.
remedies: Clean the Filters → Page 23.
Clean the Drain pump → Page 32. Program has not yet ended. ▶ Wait until the program ends or terminate the program with Reset. ▶ → "Terminating the wash cycle", Page 19
causes.evidence: Bosch manual, page 31: "Filter system or area under the filters is blocked."

symptoms.symptom: Appliance cannot be switched on or operated.

causes.label: Software update is taking place.
remedies: Wait until the software update has finished.
causes.evidence: Bosch manual, page 31: "Software update is taking place."

causes.label: Appliance functions have failed.
remedies: Pull out the power cord plug or switch off the breaker.
Wait at least 2 minutes.
Connect the appliance to the power supply.
Switch the appliance on.
causes.evidence: Bosch manual, page 31: "Appliance functions have failed."

causes.label: The breaker has tripped.
remedies: Check the relevant breaker.
causes.evidence: Bosch manual, page 31: "The breaker has tripped."

causes.label: Power cord is not inserted.
remedies: Check whether the power outlet is working.
Check whether the power cord plug is properly inserted in the power outlet and
on the rear of the appliance.
causes.evidence: Bosch manual, page 31: "Power cord is not inserted."

causes.label: Appliance door is not closed properly.
remedies: Close the appliance door.
causes.evidence: Bosch manual, page 31: "Appliance door is not closed properly."

causes.label: You did not wait until the cycle ended.
remedies: → "Terminating the wash cycle", Page 19
causes.evidence: Bosch manual, page 31: "You did not wait until the cycle ended."

causes.label: Door lock has been activated.
remedies: Close the appliance door with greater force.
causes.evidence: Bosch manual, page 31: "Door lock has been activated."
